Family-owned  ·  Pinellas County

About Xtreme Jetski Watersports

More than a jet ski rental. It's the way Tampa Bay is meant to be experienced.

Our story

Built by locals who were tired of bad rentals

Xtreme Jetski Watersports started with a simple idea: jet ski rentals should be safe, stress-free and genuinely fun. Not rushed, not restricted and not full of hidden fees.

We're locals who know Tampa Bay, the Intracoastal and the Gulf of Mexico inside and out. As a family-owned business serving Pinellas County, we take pride in a more personal, higher-quality day on the water.

“We spent years watching riders leave disappointed after being confined to small riding zones, surprised by extra charges or handed outdated equipment. We knew there was a better way, so we created it.”

What sets us apart

The Xtreme standard

01

No passenger fees. Ever.

Bring a second rider at no extra cost. What you see at checkout is what you pay.

02

Unrestricted riding areas

No tiny circles and no excessive no-wake zones. Real water, set each day around wind and tide.

03

New Yamaha WaveRunners

Modern, well-maintained skis with Bluetooth audio, not tired base models.

04

Brand-new life jackets

Fresh, Coast Guard-approved PFDs for every guest, plus a complimentary orientation before launch.

05

Plenty of availability

Open 7 days, with room to fit you in even during peak season. Reservations recommended March through September.

06

Personal, not corporate

Owner-operated and hospitality-driven. Every ride is tailored to your group, first-timers included.

Our promise

We never rush you. We never cut corners.

Captain Mike leads the tours, and the whole crew runs on the same rules: safety first, honest pricing, great equipment and a day you'll talk about. Questions before you book? Call, text or email and we'll help you pick the right ride.

Safety is always the top priority  ·  No hidden costs  ·  No shortcuts on equipment

Check Availability Call (813) 538-4802
